name: Prisma Dual Decurions
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

groups.activity: buy the Prisma Dual Decurions outright
groups.meta: stock rotates, roughly two or three visits a year

rows.label: Prisma Dual Decurions
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Dual Decurions isn't guaranteed even when he is. Check any Ducat Kiosk countdown to see which relay he's visiting.
Have the 175,000 credits ready too; it catches low-level players out more than the Ducats.

disclosures.title: using it as a Heavy Weapon
disclosures.body: Wielding it on the ground needs the Archgun Deployer (inbox reward after Profit-Taker phase 3), plus an Orokin Catalyst and a Gravimag installed on the gun. Otherwise level it in Archwing missions or on a Necramech.
